persons.notes: No institutional knowledge of the specific childhood harm is established. Later joint therapy with her mother is not described in sufficient detail to attribute a response.

coder_notes: All eleven season chunks were read in full, including historical voting discussion, case updates, crossover and trailer. Build printed LINE COUNTS MATCH. Eight potentially related unassigned episodes were read in full. Notes are /tmp/notes.md. No outside fact checking or other seasons were used. Unknown institutional reach is not equated with affirmative nonreporting. Repeated contacts summarized collectively cannot be dated or counted exactly. Missing-person deaths are not confirmed by this interview. Ads for other shows, hypothetical examples, statistics and bare mentions without aftermath are not coded as individual season stories. Quotes preserve transcription errors except required perpetrator redaction. Protection is not inferred simply from escape, recovery, publicity, or a posthumous conviction.
